entity-provider.tracking/authored/bounde.purpose: Every state, history, batch and complete snapshot a handle opened from a checkpoint answers equals what a completely verified handle answers on the same store.

entity-provider.tracking/authored/checkp.purpose: A store truncated behind its open checkpoint refuses ProviderTracked opens, not FullVerification ones, until the checkpoint is discarded.
With a checkpoint at the head, a second SQLite connection changes blob content without moving the head; the next ProviderTracked open refuses.
With a checkpoint at the head, a second SQLite connection deletes a bound blob without moving the head; the next ProviderTracked open refuses.
With a checkpoint at the head, a second SQLite connection changes event content without moving the head; the next ProviderTracked open refuses.
With a checkpoint at the head, a second SQLite connection substitutes the stream identity; the next ProviderTracked open refuses.
With a checkpoint at the head, a second SQLite connection replaces every subject index row; the next ProviderTracked open refuses.

entity-provider.tracking/authored/foreig.purpose: A foreign write after the last verified observation and before the drain that persists its checkpoint makes the next open complete.

entity-provider.tracking/authored/multi-.purpose: A scoped facade read preserves requested order, duplicate and missing subjects, exact record identities and revisions, and transitioned state after an atomic multi-subject batch.

entity-provider.tracking/authored/open-a.purpose: A ProviderTracked open whose checkpoint is behind the head verifies only the three appended events after it, and answers the same states and histories a complete open answers.

entity-provider.tracking/authored/tamper.purpose: A checkpoint changed without its digest is discarded; the open verifies completely and its drain writes a valid checkpoint again.

entity-provider.tracking/authored/unchan.purpose: Repeated complete reads preserve exact record identities and revisions, and transitioned state matches a full-verification reopen.
A second SQLite connection changes blob content without advancing the event head; a warm tracked read and reopen refuse.
A second SQLite connection changes delete-blob content without advancing the event head; a warm tracked read and reopen refuse.
A second SQLite connection changes event content without advancing the event head; a warm tracked read and reopen refuse.
A second SQLite connection changes identity content without advancing the event head; a warm tracked read and reopen refuse.
A second SQLite connection changes projection content without advancing the event head; a warm tracked read and reopen refuse.
